title: Vehicle Purchase Agreements Refund Timing Schedule
content:
Kestrel refunds money on Vehicle Purchase Agreements within business days set per vehicle program. Business days are Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays.

| Vehicle program | Reservation deposit refund | Refund after pre-handover cancellation | Credit balance refund on a completed order | Return inspection and return charges posted (after the vehicle is received) | Refund after a completed return | ACH down payment clearing hold before its refund is released |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Value Line | 5 | 5 | 7 | 2 | 10 | 5 |
| Kestrel Inspected | 5 | 5 | 7 | 2 | 10 | 5 |
| Kestrel Certified | 5 | 5 | 7 | 2 | 7 | 5 |
| Kestrel Certified Plus | 5 | 5 | 7 | 2 | 7 | 5 |
| Kestrel Premium Certified | 5 | 5 | 7 | 2 | 5 | 5 |
| Kestrel Factory Certified | 5 | 5 | 7 | 2 | 5 | 5 |

All figures are business days.

**What each column measures.**
- Reservation deposit refund: the period within which a refundable deposit is returned to the original card or account.
- Refund after pre-handover cancellation: the period within which customer-paid funds are refunded after the order is cancelled before handover.
- Credit balance refund: the period within which a credit balance on a completed order is refunded.
- Return inspection: the period after the returned vehicle is received within which the inspection is completed and return charges are posted.
- Refund after a completed return: the period after the return is completed within which customer-paid funds are refunded.
- ACH clearing hold: the number of business days an ACH down payment must have cleared before its refund is released.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A return on a Kestrel Inspected order completed on a Monday in a week with no federal holiday has a refund period of 10 business days, which runs through the Monday two weeks later.
